description: Player-level independent audit ledger. A team is eligible for ranked play only when every player has a matched/corrected audit row, exact tournament position and club value, and primary plus secondary source URLs. Never set a team status to verified based on row counts alone.

czech-republic-2026.notes: All 26 roster rows were compared manually by shirt number, player identity, position and tournament-time club against FIFA's final squad PDF (page 15) and NBC Sports' confirmed Czechia squad list. FIFA labels the team Czechia; the repository source labels it Czech Republic. Both identify CZE. Clubs in the ledger preserve the repository's normalized club names while matching the club identities in FIFA's PDF.

germany-2026.notes: All 26 roster rows were compared by shirt number, player identity, position and tournament-time club against FIFA's final squad PDF (page 20). Bundesliga.com's 11 June final-squad list independently confirms all 26 names, including Assan Ouédraogo. The DFB's 5 June replacement notice independently confirms that Lennart Karl was injured and Ouédraogo replaced him. The DFB's 2 June squad-number announcement and NBC Sports' 11 June list still include Karl, so both are treated as stale for final-squad membership.
